title: The Autumn Bell — Koyo-ji Buddhist Temple
description: A riverbank Buddhist sanctuary in autumn: pilgrims cross a vermilion bridge over koi water toward an open golden Buddha hall; a three-storey pagoda carries the bronze temple bell. Deep timber verandas, sweeping tiled eaves, shoji screens, a raked garden and a spreading maple complete the connected display.

sections.name: Open Buddha hall and timber veranda
